title: The Sapphire Likeness Canon
summary: A canon of the sapphire academy that casts the likeness as bright as the student and teaches it to pass through a barrier as the student does.

title: The Skysworn Treatise on Standing Shades
summary: A treatise of the Skysworn on shades that stand in ranks and hold a post against a heavy soul-assault without wavering.

title: The Azure Guard's Book of Doubles
summary: A book of the Azure Guard on doubles that take a blow and turn it back and on a counterpart so exact that it fights alone.

title: Canon of the Unseen Retinue
summary: A canon that keeps a retinue of echoes entirely hidden from soul-sense until the moment it is spent in one great release.

title: The Stormwing Phantom Cycle
summary: A cycle of the Stormwing Order that sends phantoms diving like raptors and ends in a storm of them over the field.

title: The Oath-Voices' Book of Wraiths
summary: A book of the Oath-Voices on wraiths bound to a spoken pledge that witness and avenge and keep faith with those who swore.

title: The Long Coast Doubles Canon
summary: A canon of patient doubles that linger and spread across a wide soul-field and then close on a target together.

title: The Last Echo Treatise
summary: A treatise for the soul that has taken full form and can cast a standing entity that lives for a breath apart from the body.
